feature_transform.jockey_affiliation: clean(raw): strip leading/trailing whitespace; null/explicit-empty -> __MISSING__; no other normalization
feature_transform.log_prize_1: log1p(prize_1) if prize_1 is not null else null
feature_transform.log_prize_total: log1p(sum(non-null prize_1..prize_5)) if any prize_1..prize_5 is non-null else null

t15_prediction_source.source: exact same T15 official current-card raw archive referenced by current_info_snapshots.raw_capture_id/source_captures
t15_prediction_source.availability: must be captured within the frozen T15_STANDARD predecision window

jockey_affiliation.binding: exact active runner row; exact official /kis_info/<id>.do jockey anchor in that row; explicit displayed affiliation token belonging to that jockey in the same runner row
jockey_affiliation.output: inner affiliation semantic text without presentation parentheses, with only leading/trailing whitespace stripped

prizes.binding: explicit race-level prize schedule on the same official pre-race card, bound to current race identity and ordinal places 1..5

unit_conversion.万円: exact Decimal amount multiplied by 10000; result must be integral yen

prizes.parser_absence_or_ambiguity: HARD_BLOCK, never treat as null or zero

post_settlement_eb_update_source.source: retained OFFICIAL_CARD raw archive in p2_live_history_delta source_captures, not the result raw archive
post_settlement_eb_update_source.purpose: reconstruct pre-race-safe fixed-M2 inputs after settlement for future-date EB residual state only
post_settlement_eb_update_source.jockey_affiliation_semantics: same parser and normalization as T15 source; use final official card runner identity actually associated with the state-update runner
post_settlement_eb_update_source.prize_semantics: same race-level parser and yen conversion as T15 source

null_and_error_semantics.prize_zero: accept only if explicitly displayed as numeric zero; do not synthesize zero

prospective_source_audit.eb_card_scope: all retained South-Kanto OFFICIAL_CARD source captures from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-03 needed for state updates
prospective_source_audit.t15_required_coverage: 100% of active runner jockey affiliations plus race prize schedule, allowing only explicit source-null semantics
prospective_source_audit.eb_required_coverage: 100% of active/current-card runner rows needed for eventual actual-starter state update plus race prize schedule
